newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo Corp sees '97 exports at $15 bln.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo Corp sees '97 exports at $15 bln.

text.p: Daewoo Corp, a trading arm of South Korea's Daewoo Group, said on Monday it had set an export target of $15 billion in calendar 1997, up from an estimated $13.1 billion this year.
A Daewoo spokesman said the company planned to increase exports of plants, equipments and components in automobile, electronics and machinery sectors.
"We'll also strengthen and expand our overseas distribution networks to help increase exports," he said.
Further details will be released later, he said.
